back_translation: Woe to those who go down to Egypt to ask for help, who lean on horses, who trust in chariots because they are many and in horsemen because they are very strong, but do not look to the Holy One of Israel and do not seek the LORD.
Yet He too is full of wisdom! He brings disaster and does not call back His words. He will rise up against the house of evildoers and against the helpers of those who work iniquity.
The Egyptians are men, not God; their horses are flesh, not spirit. When the LORD stretches out His hand, the helper will stumble and the one being helped will fall; both will perish together.

For the LORD has said this to me: "As a lion or a young lion growls over its prey — and though a whole band of shepherds is called out against it, it is not terrified by their shouting nor does it retreat at their clamor — so the LORD of Hosts will come down to wage war upon Mount Zion and upon its hill.
Like birds hovering protectively over the nest, so the LORD of Hosts will protect Jerusalem. He will protect and rescue it; He will pass over it and deliver it."
O children of Israel, return to Him against whom you have so deeply rebelled.
For in that day every one of you will reject his idols of silver and idols of gold, which your own hands have sinfully made.
"Then Assyria will fall by a sword not of man; a sword not of mortals will devour him. He will flee from that sword, and his young men will be conscripted into slave labor.
His rock will melt away from terror, and his princes will be shattered with dread at the signal banner," declares the LORD, who has His fire in Zion and His furnace in Jerusalem.
